# Swimming — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where did Swimming originate?", "Ancient"),
    ("How is Swimming scored?", "fastest time"),
    ("What is origin?", "Ancient, 1896 (Olympic)"),
    ("What is players?", "individual"),
    ("What is equipment?", "suit, goggles, cap"),
    ("What is venue?", "pool (50m)"),
    ("What is scoring?", "fastest time"),
    ("What is governing body?", "World Aquatics"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
